npcs.name: Aine
npcs.idle: My boys. Both my boys. One I put out, one ran after him.

npcs.name: Champion Fiachra
npcs.idle: My patrol went west. One came back. One's going to burn.

npcs.name: Scout Niamh
npcs.idle: Azure robes, wicker men, and a lot of singing. The west's gone strange.

quests.title: Two Brothers
quests.offer:
My husband put our eldest, Ruairc, out of the house last spring for thieving. He went to the rowdies in the west - the gang of youths that rob the road.

Now my little one, Colm, has run off after him. He's nine. He thinks it's an adventure. Will you [find Colm]? And - if you see Ruairc - tell him his mother asks after him.
quests.summary: Aine's eldest son was put out of the house and joined the road-gang in the west. Now her youngest has run off after him.

steps.goal: Deal with the villainous youths on the road
steps.text: 'Colm? The little one? He's with Ruairc's lot at the old camp. Ruairc's the boss now.'
A ragged camp of boys and young men. A little lad in a too-big cap is trying very hard to look tough.
The young man drops his cudgel and sits down in the mud. 'Fine. FINE. Take him home. He's a terrible thief anyway.'

stages.name: Ruairc the Rowdy
stages.announce: A tall young man with his mother's eyes steps in front of the little one. 'He's my brother. He stays with me.'

steps.say:
Ruairc said I could be in the gang! I can throw a stone further than anyone! ...Is Mam cross?

Ruairc says he can't come home because Da said. But he wants to. He told me. He cries at night. Don't tell him I [told].

COLM. You - come here. Come HERE.

...You saw Ruairc? How did he look? Is he thin? Did he ask after me?

His father swore he'd never set foot in the house again. If I [bring both home], his father and I will have words, and maybe worse. Or I take [only Colm], and keep the peace, and Ruairc stays out there. Tell me what to do. I've been asking the fire all year.

options.say: Then go back and tell him his mother says come home. And if his father says a word, his father can sleep in the byre.
Only Colm. ...Gods forgive me. I'll leave a loaf on the west road every week. Maybe he'll find it.

both.text: Take this. Both my boys are home.

quests.title: The Wicker Man
quests.offer:
My patrol went west to watch the Azure Order - the idolaters in blue who've been gathering by the old stones. One man came back. He says the rest are dead, except Ronan.

They've built a wicker man. At the next moon, Ronan goes inside it and they set it alight. Scout [Niamh] has seen their camp. Will you [save Ronan]?

topics.Niamh: My best scout. By the gate.

quests.summary: The Azure Order captured a patrol from the keep; the last survivor is to be burned in a wicker man.

steps.goal: Ask Scout Niamh about the Azure camp
steps.say: They've idolaters chanting at the stones, west and north. Past them, a wicker man three times my height. Haunted, too - the old wickermen they've burned walk about at night. Go through the [idolaters] first. They'll raise the alarm otherwise.

steps.text: A Connacht patrol spear, snapped and laid on the altar as an offering. A blue robe folded beside it - a new one, a recruit's - with Ronan's name pinned to it.

steps.goal: Free Ronan from the wicker man
steps.text: The idolaters scatter. Ronan climbs down from the wicker man, coughing, a blue robe still over his arm.

stages.name: Keep Ronan alive
stages.announce: You hack at the wicker. Ronan yells from inside. Every idolater on the hill turns.
stages.thanks: I'm out. I'm out. I'm OUT.

stages.name: Maelgwn, Voice of the Azure
stages.announce: A tall idolater in deep blue. 'The fire wanted him. It will have you instead.'
stages.success: Maelgwn, Voice of the Azure falls.

steps.say:
They gave me this robe. Said I could take it and live, if I'd join. I didn't. But I could have. I thought about it.

With it, I could walk into any Azure camp in Hibernia. Find out what they're planning. Tell the Champions. If I [go undercover], nobody can know - not even my mother. Or I [come home], burn the robe, and forget the whole thing.

options.say: Then I'm dead, as far as anyone knows. Tell Fiachra the truth. Only Fiachra.
Home. Gods, yes. And the robe goes in the first fire I see.

steps.say:
He's gone into the Azure, wearing their robe. His mother's been told he died a hero.

Gods. He's braver than I am. If word comes, it'll come to me. Take this - and say nothing to anyone.

Ronan's home. He burned the robe in the courtyard, and the whole keep cheered.

One man from six. It's not a victory. But it's one man. Take this.
